title: 산업융합 촉진법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Designation of Industry-Academia-Government Collaboration Centers)
① Any person seeking to be designated as an Industry-Academia-Government Collaboration Center (hereinafter referred to as "the Center") in accordance with Article 26(1) of the Act must submit an application for designation to the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy, attaching the documents specified in Form 1, along with the following:
1. Articles of incorporation or operational regulations
2. Information on personnel responsible for the Center, including documents proving that the personnel meet the requirements specified in item (2) of paragraph (1) of the "Act on Promotion of Industry-Academia-Government Collaboration" (hereinafter referred to as "the Ordinance") and a staffing plan.
3. Business plan for the Center's activities as specified in items (2) of Article 26 of the Act.

② When the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy designates a Center in accordance with Article 26(1) of the Act, the Minister must issue a designation certificate for the Industry-Academia-Government Collaboration Center to the applicant, and must also publish the designation in the official gazette or on the internet homepage in accordance with Article 31(2) of the Ordinance.
